analyst_view.overall: NEC (12th, 7 points) and Rennes (17th, 6 points) are both in the play-off places and a win would push either toward the top eight. NEC lost 4-1 at home to PSV on Saturday, have not won a league home game this season and have conceded in 20 straight games; Bram Nuytinck and Perr Schuurs are out (Schuurs counted), and Flashscore now has Philippe Sandler back in a back three, which softens this morning's view of a makeshift defence. Rennes are four without a win and six away games without a win (16 conceded); Valentin Rongier (thigh, counted) and Mahdi Camara (ankle) missed Wednesday's training, so Franck Haise may field a new-look midfield with Thomasson, Szymanski and Cisse, while Esteban Lepaul is expected to start and Frankowski is out (counted). Both sides play again in the league three days later; Serbian referee Nenad Minakovic (about 3.9 cards a game) is already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals and take about 9% off NEC for Schuurs, but they do not see that NEC also lack Nuytinck at the back or that Rennes may lose both Rongier and Camara from midfield, which weakens their control. Sandler's likely return makes NEC's defence less thin than I feared this morning, so I keep only a small lean higher, to about 3.5.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.6 corners, already adjusted for NEC winning more corners lately (38 in six) and Rennes fewer. The absences are in NEC's defence and Rennes's central midfield and do not change how either side gets the ball wide, so I stay at 9.6.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.0 cards, with referee Nenad Minakovic slightly below average (3.9 a game) and Rennes's calm recent card count already in. Thomasson's red in Ligue 1 does not carry over to Europe and there is no history between the sides, so I stay at 4.0.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.2 shots, already raised for NEC's busy recent shooting (105 in six). Gaps in both teams could open the game, but possible rotation before the weekend pulls the other way, so I stay at 29.2.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.4 shots on target. Without Nuytinck at the back for NEC and with Rennes's midfield shield weakened, both sides should get some clean chances, so I lean slightly higher, to about 10.6.
